title: TikTok from @gulfcoastgranny_travels: "Plague Ship" Lido Video

fields.caption: PLAGUE SHIP. 300 sick on the Halcyon Dawn and they closed the buffet, people locked in cabins, nobody is telling us ANYTHING. Pray for us 🙏 #HalcyonDawn #PlagueShip #cruisenightmare #norovirus
fields.overlayText: 300 SICK and nobody will tell us anything
fields.thumbnailBrief: vertical phone video still on a sunny cruise ship pool deck: a crew member in blue gown, mask and gloves spraying a stainless steel handrail, empty deck chairs, a closed buffet counter with roped-off stanchions in the background, slightly shaky handheld framing
fields.videoBrief: 41-second handheld vertical phone clip walking along a cruise ship Lido deck, following a gowned and gloved crew member spraying and wiping handrails, then panning to a roped-off buffet area and a few guests watching from deck chairs

instructorNote: Pressure inject. Show the video on screen, then give COMMS the Gulf 8 phone slip (09:14, Priya Nandakumar, 713-555-0142, desk@gulf8news.example, asking "confirm 300? coming back early?", deadline 10:30, live at noon) and the 09:16 hotline log (23 calls in 16 minutes, one daughter calling every ten minutes). Watch for these steps: PH checks the "300" claim against the 06:00 log (61 passengers, 12 crew, signed 06:15) within 30 minutes and gives COMMS the facts in writing. Then COMMS answers the post, Gulf 8 and the hotline with the same signed count and time and says the ship is sailing on schedule to Galveston. COMMS should not deny the post or say anything about the cause or the lab results, and the Wi-Fi stays on.

mediaBrief.imagePrompt: Candid smartphone snapshot, slight tilt, natural color balance, neutral white balance. Vertical handheld phone snapshot on a sunny cruise ship pool deck in mid-morning, slightly tilted and shaky framing. In the foreground a crew member in a light blue disposable gown, surgical mask and purple nitrile gloves sprays a stainless steel handrail with a handheld spray bottle, a white cloth in the other h. Behind them, rows of empty white deck chairs beside a bright blue pool, and a closed buffet counter with its shutters down, cordoned off by chrome stanchions and red velvet ropes. A few passengers in sun hats and cover-ups watch from deck chairs at a distance, seen mostly from the side. Harsh tropical sunlight, deep blue sky, uneasy, quiet mood. Setting: a cruise ship atrium on embarkation day: passengers with lanyards, a curved staircase, a glass elevator, a welcome desk, bright overhead light

mediaBrief.videoPrompt: Vertical handheld phone clip, shaky and walking, on a sunlit cruise ship pool deck in the morning. The camera follows a crew member in a blue disposable gown, mask and gloves as they spray and wipe a long stainless steel handrail, moving slowly along the rail. The phone then pans unsteadily to the right, past empty deck chairs and a still blue pool, to a closed buffet counter with shutters down behind chrome stanchions and red ropes. It ends on a few passengers in sun hats sitting quietly in deck chairs, watching the cleaning. Bright, harsh sunlight, light sea breeze moving the towels, tense and quiet mood.
